events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWKEY

The National Weather Service in Key West has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Gulf Waters from East Cape Sable to Chokoloskee 20 to 60 nm out and
beyond 5 fathoms...
Gulf of America from west end of Seven Mile Bridge to Halfmoon
Shoal out to 5 fathoms...
Hawk Channel from west end of Seven Mile Bridge to Halfmoon Shoal
out to the reef...

* Until 600 PM EDT.

* At 523 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Smith Shoal
Light, moving west at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...National Weather Service Meteorologist.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

* Locations in the warning include...
Smith Shoal Light, Ellis Rock Light, and Marquesas Keys.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Coastal Palm Beach County; Coastal Broward County
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Moderate coastal flooding expected during periods of
high tide. Dangerous beach conditions with a high rip current
risk and large breaking waves around 5 to 8 feet.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County and Coastal Broward County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, through Sunday. For the
High Rip Current Risk and High Surf Advisory, through at least
Monday morning.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Dangerous swimming and
surfing conditions and localized beach erosion. Rip currents
can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper
water.

possible.
